1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
31: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
32: 
33: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
34: PORTNUM=0
35: 
36: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
37: #
38: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
39: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
40: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
41: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
42: # nothing typed into it worked.
43: BAUD=115200
44: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
45: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
46: LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
47: REBOOT_TRIES=8
48: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
49: 
50: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
51: #
52: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
53: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
54: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
55: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
56: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
57: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
58: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
59: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
60: TEST_ONLY=0
61: 
62: usage() {
63:   cat <<'EOF'
64: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
65: 
66:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
67:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
68:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
69:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
70:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
71:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
72:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
73:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
74:   -h           显示本帮助
75: 
76: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
77:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
78: EOF
79: }
80: 
81: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
82:   case "$opt" in
83:     i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
84:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
88:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
89:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
90:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
91:     h) usage; exit 0 ;;
92:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
93:   esac
94: done
95: 
96: die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
97: 
98: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查
99: 
100: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
101: [ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"
102: [ -c "$PORT" ]   || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
103: mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"
104: 
105: SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$IMAGE")
106: SHA=$(sha256sum "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
107: 
108: # 10 bits on the wire per byte (8N1 plus start and stop).
109: XFER_SECS=$(( SIZE * 10 / BAUD ))
110: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
111: 
112: echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
113: echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
114: echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
115: echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
116: echo "  串口   : $PORT"
117: echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
118: echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud（烧完会恢复成这个）"
119: 
120: if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
121:   if [ "$SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
122:     die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE。打包可能不完整，用 -s 可跳过此检查"
123:   fi
124:   echo "  字节数校验通过"
125: fi
126: 
127: # ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. 释放串口占用
128: 
129: echo
130: echo "=== 释放串口 ==="
131: HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
132: if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
133:   echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
134: 
135:   pkill -f "picocom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
136:   pkill -f "minicom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
137: 
138:   sleep 0.5
139:   HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
140:   if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
141:     die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS。手动处理后重试（参考 docs/端口冲突解决办法.md）"
142:   fi
143: fi
144: echo "  串口空闲"
145: 
146: # Console baud, not flash baud: the only thing written through this port
147: # before bk_loader takes over is the "reboot" command, and the firmware's
148: # console is listening at CONSOLE_BAUD.
149: stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
150:   || die "stty 配置失败"
151: 
152: # --------------------------------------------------- 3. 启动 bk_loader 并软复位
153: 
154: echo
155: : > "$LOG"
156: PIDFILE="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.$$.pid"
157: : > "$PIDFILE"
158: 
159: # The in-loop reset works at any -b, and here is why it is safe to rely on:
160: # bk_loader opens the tty at 115200 no matter what -b says, handshakes there,
161: # and only switches to the requested rate once it owns the bus.  Measured from
162: # a real 1500000 run:
163: #
164: #   cmdline: ... bk_loader download -p 0 -b 1500000 ...
165: #   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
166: #   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully
167: #
168: # So while we are writing "reboot" the line is still at 115200 and the
169: # firmware console decodes it fine.  An earlier version of this script
170: # disabled the retry loop for BAUD != CONSOLE_BAUD on the theory that the port
171: # had already been switched up -- that was reasoning without measurement, and
172: # it broke a mechanism that worked.
173: 
174: if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
175:   echo "=== 只测握手，不写 flash ==="
176:   set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash_probe.bin@0-1000"
177: else
178:   echo "=== 开始烧录（无需按 RST）==="
179:   set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
180: fi
181: 
182: # Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
183: #
184: # bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,
185: # which emits "Erasing Flash ... 42%\r" -- carriage return, no newline.  Two
186: # things are needed to see that live: tee, so the bytes reach the terminal at
187: # all, and stdbuf -o0, because with a pipe on stdout glibc would otherwise
188: # block-buffer 4 KB at a time and the bar would arrive in lurches.
189: #
190: # The PID is stashed in a file because with a pipeline $! would be tee's.
191: (
192:   stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" &
193:   echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
194:   wait $!
195: ) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
196: PIPELINE_PID=$!
197: 
198: LOADER_PID=""
199: for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
200:   if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then LOADER_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE"); break; fi
201:   sleep 0.1
202: done
203: [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] || die "无法获取 bk_loader 进程号"
204: 
205: # Wait for it to actually enter the retry loop before poking the board.
206: for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
207:   grep -q "Getting Bus" "$LOG" && break
208:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
209:   sleep 0.1
210: done
211: 
212: if ! kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
213:   echo "  bk_loader 提前退出:"
214:   tail -5 "$LOG" | sed 's/^/    | /'
215:   wait "$LOADER_PID"; exit 1
216: fi
217: 
218: GOT_BUS=0
219: 
220: echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"
221: 
222: for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
223:   if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
224:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
225: 
226:   # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the
227:   # CP shell first: Ctrl-] then '.'.
228:   #
229:   # The trailing newline after the escape is essential.  Without it the CP
230:   # shell buffers all of it as a single line and sees "\x1d.reboot", answers
231:   # "cmd NOT found: .reboot" and never resets -- which made every attempt here
232:   # fall through to the manual RST prompt.  Measured: with the flush the board
233:   # reboots, without it it never does.
234:   printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
235:   printf '.'    > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
236:   printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
237:   printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
238:   echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"
239:

188: /****************************************************************************
189:  * Name: aud_ana_write
190:  *
191:  * Description:
192:  *   Write one analog register and wait for the analog-SPI shadow transfer
193:  *   to retire, mirroring sys_ll_set_analog_reg_value() in
194:  *   bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_ll.h:51-59.
195:  *
196:  ****************************************************************************/
197: 
198: static int aud_ana_write(unsigned int reg, uint32_t value)
199: {
200:   uint32_t limit = AUD_ANA_POLL_LIMIT;
201: 
202:   putreg32(value, BK7258_ANA_REG(reg));
203: 
204:   while ((getreg32(BK7258_ANA_SPI_STATE) & BK7258_ANA_SPI_BUSY(reg)) != 0)
205:     {
206:       if (limit-- == 0)
207:         {
208:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
209:         }
210:     }
211: 
212:   return OK;
213: }

220:  *   register read (the shadow is readable directly, see
221:  *   sys_ll_get_analog_reg_value()); only the write needs the poll.
222:  *
223:  ****************************************************************************/

225: static int aud_ana_modify(unsigned int reg, uint32_t clrbits,
226:                           uint32_t setbits)

228:   uint32_t value = getreg32(BK7258_ANA_REG(reg));
229: 
230:   value &= ~clrbits;
231:   value |= setbits;
232: 
233:   return aud_ana_write(reg, value);

763: bk_err_t bk_sdio_host_wait_cmd_response(uint32_t cmd_index)
764: {
765: #if CONFIG_SDIO_V2P0
766: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
767: 	uint32_t msg = 0;
768: #endif
769: 
770: 	SDIO_HOST_RETURN_ON_NOT_INIT();
771: 	SDIO_PM_CHECK_RESTORE(0);
772: 
773: 	uint32_t int_status = sdio_host_hal_get_interrupt_status(&s_sdio_host.hal);
774: 
775: #if CONFIG_SDIO_V2P0
776: 	{
777: 		//TODO:Timeout and CRC fail should use different case
778: 		//FreeRTOS doesn't use EVENT,so use msg queue.
779: 		ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&s_sdio_host.irq_cmd_msg, &msg, SDIO_CMD_WAIT_TIME);
780: 		if(ret)
781: 		{
782: 			SDIO_HOST_LOGV("sdio wait slave CMD%d timeout, int_status=0x%x, ret=%d\r\n", cmd_index, int_status, ret);
783: 			return BK_ERR_SDIO_HOST_CMD_RSP_TIMEOUT;
784: 		}
785: 	}
786: #else
787: 	/* wait until cmd response */
788: 	BK_WHILE (!sdio_host_hal_is_cmd_rsp_interrupt_triggered(&s_sdio_host.hal, int_status)) {
789: 		int_status = sdio_host_hal_get_interrupt_status(&s_sdio_host.hal);
790: 	}
791: 
792: 	/* clear command response int status */
793: 	sdio_host_hal_clear_cmd_rsp_interrupt_status(&s_sdio_host.hal, int_status);
794: 
795: 	if (sdio_host_hal_is_cmd_rsp_timeout_interrupt_triggered(&s_sdio_host.hal, int_status)) {
796: 		if (cmd_index != SEND_OP_COND) {
797: 			SDIO_HOST_LOGW("sdio wait slave CMD%d timeout\r\n", cmd_index);
798: 			return BK_ERR_SDIO_HOST_CMD_RSP_TIMEOUT;
799: 		}
800: 	}
801: 
802: 	if (sdio_host_hal_is_cmd_rsp_crc_fail_interrupt_triggered(&s_sdio_host.hal, int_status)) {
803: 		if ((cmd_index != SD_APP_OP_COND) &&
804: 			(cmd_index != ALL_SEND_CID) &&
805: 			(cmd_index != SEND_CSD) &&
806: 			(cmd_index != SEND_OP_COND)) {
807: 			SDIO_HOST_LOGW("sdio receive slave CMD%d crc fail\r\n", cmd_index);
808: 			return BK_ERR_SDIO_HOST_CMD_RSP_CRC_FAIL;
809: 		}
810: 	}
811: #endif
812: 	return BK_OK;
813: }

71: {
72:   uint32_t value;
73: 
74:   /* SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE2: SDIO divider [16:14], source [17]. */
75:   value = getreg32(0x44010024u);
76:   value &= ~((7u << 14) | (1u << 17));

82: static void sdio_reset_hw(struct bk7258_sdio_s *priv)
83: {
84:   uint32_t value;
85: 
86:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_MASK, 0);
87:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS, 0xffffffffu);
88: 
89:   value = sdio_read(BK7258_SDIO_FIFO);
90:   value &= ~0xffu;
91:   value |= 1u;
92:   value |= BK7258_SDIO_FIFO_RX_RESET | BK7258_SDIO_STATE_RESET |
93:            BK7258_SDIO_CLOCK_GATE | BK7258_SDIO_HOST_READ_BLOCK;
94:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_FIFO, value);
95: 
96:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMER, BK7258_SDIO_TIMEOUT);
97:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_DATA_TIMER, BK7258_SDIO_TIMEOUT);
98:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_DATA_CTRL, BK7258_SDIO_DATA_BYTE_SELECT);
99:   sdio_set_clock(priv, BK7258_SDIO_ID_CLOCK);
100: }

102: static int sdio_wait_command(struct bk7258_sdio_s *priv, uint32_t cmd)
103: {
104:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(1000);
105:   uint32_t status;
106: 
107:   for (;;)
108:     {
109:       status = sdio_read(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS);
110:       if ((status & (BK7258_SDIO_CMD_NO_RESPONSE |
111:                      BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE_END |
112:                      BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT)) != 0)
113:         {
114:           break;
115:         }
116: 
117:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
118:         {
119:           printf("SDIO CMD%u timeout status=0x%08lx\n",
120:                  (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
121:                  (unsigned long)status);
122:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
123:         }
124: 
125:       nxsig_usleep(100);
126:     }
127: 
128:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS,
129:              status & (BK7258_SDIO_CMD_NO_RESPONSE |
130:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE_END |
131:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT |
132:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_OK |
133:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_FAIL));
134: 
135:   if ((status & BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT) != 0)
136:     {
137:       printf("SDIO CMD%u response timeout status=0x%08lx\n",
138:              (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
139:              (unsigned long)status);
140:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
141:     }
142: 
143:   /* The BK7258 host reports CRC failure for the open-drain/long-response
144:    * identification commands even when the vendor stack accepts the response.
145:    * Armino explicitly tolerates this for ACMD41, CMD2 and CMD9.  Keep the
146:    * same compatibility rule while preserving CRC errors for normal R1/R7.
147:    */
148:   if ((status & BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_FAIL) != 0 &&
149:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != SD_ACMDIDX41 &&
150:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX2 &&
151:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX9)
152:     {
153:       printf("SDIO CMD%u CRC error status=0x%08lx\n",
154:              (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
155:              (unsigned long)status);
156:       return -EIO;
157:     }
158: 
159:   return OK;
160: }

162: static int sdio_sendcmd(FAR struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
163:                         uint32_t arg)
164: {
165:   uint32_t response;
166:   uint32_t value;
167: 
168:   response = (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT;
169:   value = ((cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) << BK7258_SDIO_CMD_INDEX_SHIFT);
170:   if (response != MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE)
171:     {
172:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE;
173:     }
174:   if (response == MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE)
175:     {
176:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_LONG;
177:     }
178:   if (response != MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE &&
179:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX2 &&
180:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX9 &&
181:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != SD_ACMDIDX41)
182:     {
183:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_CHECK;
184:     }
185: 
186:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_ARGUMENT, arg);
187:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CTRL, value | BK7258_SDIO_CMD_START);
188:   return OK;

<task_result>
**Conclusion**

The current BK7258 contest path has several independent divergences from the AP HAL/vendor implementation. The most important are:

1. It configures a one-sector transfer as multi-block: `DATA_MULTIBLOCK` plus `CMD18`.
2. It does not perform the vendor-required low-active FIFO/state reset sequence.
3. It enables automatic clock gating while reading, but stops the transfer and sends `CMD12` without first resetting the SDIO receive/state machine.
4. It uses a legacy hardcoded `0x448b000c` data-control alias in addition to the canonical BK7258 AP register.
5. It deliberately converts a data CRC failure into success.
6. It forces positive-edge sampling and does not explicitly establish the vendor default `CLK_REC_SEL=1`.
7. The PIO read loop is structurally compatible with the vendor FIFO access, but the data engine is misframed before the loop runs.

The observed `55 AA` at destination offset 170 is not explained by ordinary byte swapping. The MBR signature is normally at source offsets 510 and 511. `510 / 3 = 170`, so the symptom represents a three-to-one stream/index relationship, not a four-byte endian permutation. The simultaneous data CRC failure strongly indicates that the controller is receiving or framing more data than the software believes it is receiving, most plausibly because the read is configured as a multi-block `CMD18` transaction and the controller continues its pre-read behavior.

**1. Current contest implementation**

Relevant current code:

- [bk7258_sdio.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:86)
- [bk7258_sdio.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_sdio.h:10)

The current read setup is:

```c
value = ((priv->blocklen << 4) & block_mask)
       | DATA_BYTE_SELECT
       | DATA_MULTIBLOCK;
sdio_write(DATA_CTRL, value | DATA_ENABLE);
```

at [bk7258_sdio.c:348-353](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:348), followed by:

```c
SDIO_SENDCMD(dev, MMCSD_CMD18, sector << 9);
```

at [bk7258_sdio.c:454-457](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:454).

For a single 512-byte read, this should be the single-block combination:

```text
DATA_CTRL:
  bit 0       DATA_EN          = 1
  bit 3       DATA_MUL_BLK     = 0
  bits 4:15   DATA_BLK         = 512
  bit 17      DATA_BYTE_SEL    = 1
```

That is `0x00020201`, assuming one-bit bus operation.

The current value is `0x00020209`, with bit 3 set, and the card command is `CMD18`, which is the multi-block command. This is inconsistent with the NuttX single-sector path and creates the exact conditions for the vendor-documented pre-read behavior.

**2. Vendor command choice**

The vendor NuttX MMC/SD implementation uses `CMD17` for one block:

- [mmcsd_sdio.c:1571-1602](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1571)

It configures the block, calls `SDIO_RECVSETUP`, then sends:

```c
mmcsd_sendcmdpoll(priv, MMCSD_CMD17, offset);
```

For multiple blocks it separately uses `CMD18`:

- [mmcsd_sdio.c:1723-1765](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1723)

The AP vendor SD-card driver agrees:

- `CMD18` is explicitly the multi-block path at [sd_card_driver.c:589-617](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:589)
- `CMD17` is explicitly the single-block path at [sd_card_driver.c:625-645](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:625)

The older `sdcard` implementation also uses `CMD17` for `block_num == 1`:

- [sdcard.c:1725-1731](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdcard/sdcard.c:1725)

Recommended minimal change for `nblocks == 1`:

```c
ret = SDIO_SENDCMD(dev, MMCSD_CMD17, address);
...
ret = SDIO_WAITRESPONSE(dev, MMCSD_CMD17);
...
ret = SDIO_RECVR1(dev, MMCSD_CMD17, &response);
```

and configure `DATA_MULTIBLOCK` as zero.

Do not send `CMD12` after a `CMD17` read. The standard NuttX single-block path returns after the data event and does not issue `CMD12`; see [mmcsd_sdio.c:1595-1621](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/mmcsd/mmcsd_sdio.c:1595).

`CMD12` is needed only for an actual multi-block `CMD18` transfer. The vendor warning says that a stopped multi-block read must reset the FIFO/state machine before enabling clocks for `CMD12`:

- [sd_card_driver.c:657-668](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:657)
- [sd_card_driver.c:695-708](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:695)

The contest currently does:

```c
sdio_write(DATA_CTRL, 0);
...
value |= CLOCK_GATE;
sdio_write(FIFO, value);
...
send CMD12;
```

at [bk7258_sdio.c:476-489](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:476).

It does not perform the vendor reset transition before opening the clock for `CMD12`.

**3. FIFO readiness and read sequencing**

The AP register definition is:

- `RXFIFO_RD_READY` is bit 18 of `REG0x11`
- It means “host/slave RX FIFO not empty”
- `RX_FIFO_THRESHOLD` is bits 0:7
- The default RX threshold is `0x01`

Evidence:

- [sdio_reg.h:336-352](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h:336)
- [sdio_struct.h:150-167](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:150)
- [sdio_ll.h:296-313](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:296)

The vendor polling sequence is:

```c
while (!sdio_host_hal_is_rx_fifo_read_ready(hal))
    delay;

word = sdio_host_hal_read_fifo(hal);
```

at [sdio_host_driver.c:1178-1196](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1178).

The word is unpacked in little-endian byte order:

```c
data[index++] = read_data & 0xff;
data[index++] = (read_data >> 8) & 0xff;
data[index++] = (read_data >> 16) & 0xff;
data[index++] = (read_data >> 24) & 0xff;
```

at [sdio_host_driver.c:1205-1215](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1205).

The contest’s `sdio_drain_fifo()` follows the same basic operation:

- Test bit 18 at [bk7258_sdio.c:404-405](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:404)
- Read one `RX_FIFO` word at [bk7258_sdio.c:407](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:407)
- Copy four bytes at [bk7258_sdio.c:408-413](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:408)

Therefore, the FIFO word unpacking is not the primary problem. `DATA_BYTE_SELECT=1` plus the little-endian software unpack is the vendor-established combination.

Important threshold detail: `RX_FIFO_THRESHOLD=1` does not mean “one byte.” The vendor comments describe the default threshold as 16 bytes:

- [sdio_ll.h:27-29](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:27)

The readiness bit itself means that at least one FIFO word is available. Software must still test bit 18 before every 32-bit FIFO read. The contest does that correctly.

The vendor V2 read setup order is:

1. Set RX FIFO threshold to `0x1`.
2. Configure read block mode.
3. Configure `DATA_BLK=block_size`.
4. Set `DATA_BYTE_SEL=1`.
5. Enable data receive.
6. Set data timeout.
7. Send the read command.
8. Wait for data completion.
9. Read each FIFO word only when `RXFIFO_RD_READY` is asserted.

Evidence:

- [sdio_host_driver.c:779-796](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:779)
- [sdio_ll.h:260-279](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:260)
- [sdio_host_driver.c:1128-1146](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1128)

For the one-block contest path, use the corresponding single-block routine:

```text
RX threshold       = 0x01
RX FIFO/state reset
DATA_BUS           = 0
DATA_MUL_BLK       = 0
DATA_BLK           = 512
DATA_BYTE_SEL      = 1
DATA_EN            = 1
DATA timer         = configured timeout
CMD17
wait response
wait DATA_RECEIVE_END
drain 128 FIFO words, checking bit 18 before each read
```

Reading concurrently while the data engine is active is not inherently invalid, but the vendor PIO implementation waits for the data event and then drains the FIFO. At 100 kHz, 512 bytes take roughly 40 ms on a one-bit bus, so waiting for `DATA_RECEIVE_END` should not cause overflow if the FIFO can hold the completed block as the vendor implementation assumes. The current code’s active drain is acceptable only if the data engine has been correctly framed and reset.

**4. Reset polarity and exact reset sequence**

The AP HAL is internally inconsistent in its generated comments, but the executable vendor code is clear.

The structure header describes the bits as high-active:

- [sdio_struct.h:154-159](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h:154)

However, the low-level macro implementation says:

```c
/* low active: 0 reset
 * read value is 1, write 0 to reset,
 * ASIC auto set it to 1
 */
```

for RX FIFO reset and SD state reset:

- [sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1046-1061](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1046)
- [sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1100-1115](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll_macro_def.h:1100)

The higher-level HAL also explicitly says “reset tx/rx fifo: low active”:

- [sdio_ll.h:38-48](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:38)

The vendor reset implementation writes zero to bits 16, 17, and 20:

The contest explicitly accepts a CRC failure if all 512 requested bytes have been copied:

- [bk7258_sdio.c:549-580](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:549)

- [sdcard_driver.c:346-364](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdcard/sdio_driver.c:346)

Recommended behavior:

```text
if DATA_TIMEOUT or FIFO_OVERFLOW:
    fail

if DATA_CRC_FAIL:
    reset FIFO/state
    fail

if DATA_RECEIVE_END and remaining == 0:
    succeed
```

Do not convert `DATA_CRC_FAIL` into `SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE`. A complete byte count does not prove that the bytes belong to the requested, CRC-valid block.

- `DATA_CRC_OK = BIT(12)`
- `DATA_CRC_FAIL = BIT(13)`

  - geometry

  - MBR `55aa` 检查
  - VFAT 挂载

- 解决了原先 `/dev/mmcsd0` `ENXIO` 的主要问题：
  - 启用 `CONFIG_BCH`
  - 避免用普通 `open()` 判断 MMCSD probe 是否成功
  - 自检改为直接使用 block-driver API
- `-Werror` 构建一直可以成功。
- 完整固件能够成功打包并烧录：
  - `all-app.bin`: 2646016 bytes
  - `WriteFlash -> pass`
- 已验证 SD 卡识别命令链路正常：
  - CMD8
  - CMD55 / ACMD41

通用自检已经通过：

```text

```text
SDIO R1 CMD17=0x00000900
SDIO data error status=0x10046488 remaining=0
SDIO sector=0 nonff=10 hash=ad59c814 first=fa33c08e last=ffffffff signature=-1
FAIL storage sector0 signature=ffff

也就是说：

- CMD17 响应正常。
- PIO 路径可以搬运到完整长度。

**已确认的关键问题**

当前问题已经从“SDIO 无法识别”收敛到 BK7258 SDIO V2 数据通路：

- FIFO/state reset 的有效电平和时序需要严格匹配原厂实现。
- CMD17/CMD18、single-block/multi-block 组合会影响返回内容。
- FIFO clock gate、`CLK_REC_SEL`、FIFO threshold、data block framing 都会影响结果。
- 直接接受 CRC fail 只能作为诊断手段，目前不能视为存储适配完成。

当前最新代码和固件已经完成最后一次自动构建、打包、烧录，但 `periph_selftest` 仍是 `failures=1`。存储适配尚未完成，下一步应继续对照原厂 AP SDIO V2 的 reset、FIFO gate 和 data receive 时序，直到 sector 0 能稳定得到正确的 `55aa`。

- 完成 BK7258 目标板 GPIO14–GPIO19 SD-NAND 的 OpenVela/NuttX SDIO、MMCSD、只读 FAT/VFAT 移植。
- 全自动构建、打包、烧录并通过 UART 运行 `periph_selftest`，最终实现存储及全部外设测试 `PASS`。

## Important Details
- 工作区根目录：`/home/mi/vela_competition`
- contest 仓库：`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing`
- NuttX/OpenVela：`/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela`
- 原厂 BK7258 参考：`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`
- 用户要求“继续执行全自动流程”；应持续构建、打包、烧录、自检并根据结果修复，不停在方案阶段。
- SD-NAND pinout：
  - GPIO14：`SD_CLK`
  - GPIO15：`SD_CMD`
  - GPIO16：`SD_D0`
  - GPIO17：`SD_D1`
  - GPIO18：`SD_D2`
  - GPIO19：`SD_D3`
- U7 供电 `LDO_3V3`；CMD/D0-D3 有 `10K` 上拉；无 card-detect/write-protect。
- 首版约束：1-bit、PIO、单块、只读；禁止格式化、写入和破坏性测试。
- SDIO Host base：`0x458d0000`；IRQ 为 `BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + 10 = 26`。
- 卡初始化响应稳定：
  - OCR：`0x80ff8000`
  - CCS bit 30 为 0，因此 sector 地址需 `sector << 9`
  - CMD8/CMD55/ACMD41/CMD2/CMD3/CMD9/CMD7/CMD16/ACMD51 均有响应
- 构建：
  ```bash
  cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
  ./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh -e -Werror --cmake -j8
  ```
- 打包：
  ```bash
  podman run --rm --userns=keep-id \
    -v "/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp:/armino" \
    -w /armino localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
    make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 SDK_DIR=/armino \
    EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
  ```
- 烧录：
  ```bash
  bash /home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh \
    -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1 -b 1500000
  ```
- 串口 115200；软重启：发送 `Ctrl-]`、`.`、回车、`reboot`；进入 AP 后执行：
  ```text
  ap_console open
  periph_selftest
  ```
- `all-app.bin` 固定大小 `2646016` 字节。
- 构建持续出现无害提示：
  ```text
  grep: dor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh/defconfig: 没有那个文件或目录
  ```
- 工作区有用户已有修改，禁止回退或覆盖无关变化。
- `autoflash.sh` 曾在一次运行中瞬态报第 263 行语法错误，但随后读取内容正常，`bash -n` 已通过；未修改该用户文件。

## Work State
### Completed
- 已完成 `/home/mi/vela_competition/BK7258_OPENVELA_SDIO_PORTING_PLAN.md` V4。
- 已新增并接入：
  - `bk7258_sdio.c`
  - `bk7258_sdio.h`
  - `hardware/bk7258_sdio.h`
  - `bk7258_mmcsd.c`
  - `CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO`
  - SDIO CMake/Kconfig/IRQ/bringup/PWC 支持
- 已实现 PWC SDIO power/clock request：
  - `PM_POWER_SUBMODULE_SDIO 91`
  - `PM_CLOCK_SDIO 22`
- 已增加只读 fixed-geometry fallback：
  - `/dev/mmcsd0`
  - sector size `512`
  - sector count `2097152`
  - 不实现写入
- fallback 注册已改为无条件 `unregister_blockdriver("/dev/mmcsd0")` 后重新注册，避免标准 MMCSD probe 留下坏 inode。
- 已启用并刷新最终 Kconfig：
  - `CONFIG_BCH=y`
  - `CONFIG_BCH_DEVICE_READONLY=y`
  - `CONFIG_MMCSD=y`
  - `CONFIG_MMCSD_SDIO=y`
  - `CONFIG_MMCSD_READONLY=y`
  - `CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1`
  - `CONFIG_SDIO_WIDTH_D1_ONLY=y`
  - `CONFIG_SDIO_BLOCKSETUP=y`
  - `CONFIG_MBR_PARTITION=y`
  - `CONFIG_FS_FAT=y`
- `periph_selftest` 存储访问已改用 `open_blockdriver()`、block geometry/read API，绕开普通 `open()` 的 BCH 临时代理 `ENXIO`。
- GPIO14–GPIO19 已按原厂配置内部上拉和 drive capacity 3。
- 已确认 PIO 原始问题：
  - `100 us` sleep 导致 FIFO 在 256 字节处 overflow
  - 移除数据活跃期间 sleep 后可排空完整 512 字节
- 已确认实验性 `CMD18 + CMD12` 数据内容不可靠：
  - 6.5 MHz：`first=fa33c08e last=00000ffc`
  - 100 kHz：`55aa` 出现在 offset 170
  - 已撤销该路径
- 原厂代码交叉核对后已收敛到：
  - `CMD17`
  - 单块 data engine，未设置 `BK7258_SDIO_DATA_MULTIBLOCK`
  - byte addressing：`sector << 9`
  - 不发送 `CMD12`
  - 不写旧 alias `0x448b000c`
  - FIFO/SD state reset 按低有效语义处理
  - RX/TX threshold 为 `0x0101`
  - `BK7258_SDIO_CLOCK_RECOVERY` 置位
  - transfer clock 恢复为 6.5 MHz，`BK7258_SDIO_TRANSFER_CLOCK=1`
- 已删除旧 alias 和实验性正沿采样依赖；当前单块路径不强制 `BK7258_SDIO_SAMPLE_POSITIVE`。
- 当前 CRC 兼容仅在以下全部满足时将事件视为 transfer done：
  - 无 `BK7258_SDIO_DATA_TIMEOUT`
  - 无 `BK7258_SDIO_FIFO_OVERFLOW`
  - `priv->remaining == 0`
- `-Werror` 构建在最后一次循环中已成功，AP binary 为 `527168` 字节。
- 打包、烧录此前已多次成功；`autoflash.sh` 可自动软复位进入 bootloader。

### Active
- 最后一次全自动循环已启动：
  - 构建成功
  - 后续打包、烧录、串口自检输出被工具截断
- 需要直接检查：
  - `/tmp/bk7258_flash_last.log`
  - `/tmp/bk7258_selftest_last.log`
- 当前 `bk7258_sdio.c` 仍保留 sector 诊断：
  - `nonff`
  - FNV hash
  - first/last bytes
  - `55aa` signature offset
- 当前关键待验证结果：
  - `CMD17` 完整 512 字节 payload 是否包含 offset 510 的 `55aa`
  - MBR parser 是否成功
  - VFAT 是否只读挂载
  - `periph_selftest` 是否从存储失败收敛为全部 `PASS`

### Blocked
- 最后可见的板上结果是在 CRC 兼容重新启用之前：
  ```text
  SDIO R1 CMD17=0x00000900
  SDIO data error status=0x10046488 remaining=0
  SD-NAND has no parseable MBR, using super-floppy path: -5
  ```
- BK7258 在完整排空 512 字节后仍报告 `DATA_CRC_FAIL`；当前代码仅对完整、无 timeout/overflow 的传输兼容放行，实际 payload 尚需从最新日志确认。
- 若最新 payload 的 `55aa` 仍不在 offset 510，则不能宣称存储完成，也不能扩大 CRC 忽略范围。
- `periph_selftest` 最新最终结果未知，因为最后命令输出被截断。

## Next Move
1. 读取 `/tmp/bk7258_flash_last.log` 和 `/tmp/bk7258_selftest_last.log`，确认最后一次烧录、自检及 sector 指纹；若日志不完整，直接连接 `/dev/ttyUSB1` 重启并重新执行 `periph_selftest`。
2. 若 sector 0 为有效 `55aa`，验证 MBR/VFAT/目录及 `SELFTEST PASS`，然后移除临时 sector hash/signature 和冗余 SDIO 调试日志；若仍无效，继续对照原厂 FIFO read-ready/clock-gate 节拍，不放宽短读或 CRC 错误条件。

60: static void sdio_pinmux(void)
61: {
62:   unsigned int pin;
63: 
64:   for (pin = 14; pin <= 19; pin++)
65:     {
66:       /* Function zero is SDIO for the complete GPIO14..19 map. */
67:       bk7258_gpio_set_function(pin, 0);
68:       modifyreg32(BK7258_GPIO_CFG(pin), BK7258_GPIO_CAPACITY_MASK,
69:                   BK7258_GPIO_PULL_UP | BK7258_GPIO_PULL_ENABLE |
70:                   BK7258_GPIO_CAPACITY_3);

74: static void sdio_set_clock(struct bk7258_sdio_s *priv, uint32_t code)
75: {
76:   uint32_t value;
77: 
78:   /* SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE2: SDIO divider [16:14], source [17]. */
79:   value = getreg32(0x44010024u);
80:   value &= ~((7u << 14) | (1u << 17));
81:   value |= (code & 7u) << 14;
82:   putreg32(value, 0x44010024u);
83:   priv->clock_code = code;
84: }

86: static void sdio_reset_hw(struct bk7258_sdio_s *priv)
87: {
88:   uint32_t value;
89: 
90:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_MASK, 0);
91:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS, 0xffffffffu);
92: 
93:   value = sdio_read(BK7258_SDIO_FIFO);
94:   value &= ~(0xffffu | BK7258_SDIO_FIFO_RX_RESET |
95:              BK7258_SDIO_FIFO_TX_RESET | BK7258_SDIO_STATE_RESET);
96:   value |= 0x0101u | BK7258_SDIO_CLOCK_RECOVERY;
97:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_FIFO, value);
98: 
99:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMER, BK7258_SDIO_TIMEOUT);
100:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_DATA_TIMER, BK7258_SDIO_TIMEOUT);
101:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_DATA_CTRL, BK7258_SDIO_DATA_BYTE_SELECT);
102:   sdio_set_clock(priv, BK7258_SDIO_ID_CLOCK);

105: static int sdio_wait_command(struct bk7258_sdio_s *priv, uint32_t cmd)
106: {
107:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(1000);
108:   uint32_t status;
109: 
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       status = sdio_read(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS);
113:       if ((status & (BK7258_SDIO_CMD_NO_RESPONSE |
114:                      BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE_END |
115:                      BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT)) != 0)
116:         {
117:           break;
118:         }
119: 
120:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
121:         {
122:           printf("SDIO CMD%u timeout status=0x%08lx\n",
123:                  (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
124:                  (unsigned long)status);
125:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
126:         }
127: 
128:       /* At transfer speed the RX FIFO can fill before a 100 us sleep
129:        * expires.  Keep the PIO loop tight while data is active; otherwise a
130:        * 512-byte sector consistently overflows after the first 256 bytes. */
131:       if (!priv->data_active)
132:         {
133:           nxsig_usleep(100);
134:         }
135:     }
136: 
137:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_INT_STATUS,
138:              status & (BK7258_SDIO_CMD_NO_RESPONSE |
139:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE_END |
140:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT |
141:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_OK |
142:                        BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_FAIL));
143: 
144:   if ((status & BK7258_SDIO_CMD_TIMEOUT) != 0)
145:     {
146:       printf("SDIO CMD%u response timeout status=0x%08lx\n",
147:              (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
148:              (unsigned long)status);
149:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
150:     }
151: 
152:   /* The BK7258 host reports CRC failure for the open-drain/long-response
153:    * identification commands even when the vendor stack accepts the response.
154:    * Armino explicitly tolerates this for ACMD41, CMD2 and CMD9.  Keep the
155:    * same compatibility rule while preserving CRC errors for normal R1/R7.
156:    */
157:   if ((status & BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_FAIL) != 0 &&
158:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != SD_ACMDIDX41 &&
159:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX2 &&
160:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX9)
161:     {
162:       printf("SDIO CMD%u CRC error status=0x%08lx\n",
163:              (unsigned)(cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK),
164:              (unsigned long)status);
165:       return -EIO;
166:     }
167: 
168:   return OK;
169: }

171: static int sdio_sendcmd(FAR struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
172:                         uint32_t arg)
173: {
174:   uint32_t response;
175:   uint32_t value;
176: 
177:   response = (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT;
178:   value = ((cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) << BK7258_SDIO_CMD_INDEX_SHIFT);
179:   if (response != MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE)
180:     {
181:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_RESPONSE;
182:     }
183:   if (response == MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE)
184:     {
185:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_LONG;
186:     }
187:   if (response != MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE &&
188:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX2 &&
189:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != MMCSD_CMDIDX9 &&
190:       (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) != SD_ACMDIDX41)
191:     {
192:       value |= BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CRC_CHECK;
193:     }

195:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_ARGUMENT, arg);
196:   sdio_write(BK7258_SDIO_CMD_CTRL, value | BK7258_SDIO_CMD_START);
197:   return OK;
198: }

## Findings

### 1. The current read-block configuration does not match the BK7258 vendor path

The strongest mismatch is the programmed read block-size field.

- Current OpenVela deliberately programs multiblock mode with a **zero block-size field** for 512-byte reads:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:350-364`
  - The comment at lines 352-354 claims that the vendor lower half leaves the read block-size field at zero.

- The BK7258 vendor HAL does not do that. `sdio_host_ll_set_read_multi_block_data()` programs:
  - multiblock mode,
  - one-bit/four-bit mode,
  - `sd_data_blk = block_size & 0xfff`,
  - receive-byte swapping.
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:260-279`

- The zero-size exception is guarded by `CONFIG_SOC_BK7256XX`:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:270-274`
  - The BK7258 vendor configuration selects `CONFIG_SOC_BK7258=y`, not `CONFIG_SOC_BK7256XX`:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:7`

- The card layer passes `SD_BLOCK_SIZE`, i.e. 512, into that HAL:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:1600-1606`

- It also contains a legacy literal write intended to force the field to 512:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c:1611`

Thus the faithful BK7258 value for `DATA_CTRL` during CMD18 is:

```text
DATA_ENABLE | DATA_MULTIBLOCK | DATA_BYTE_SELECT | (512 << 4)
```

plus the selected bus-width bit. Leaving `[15:4]` zero can prevent proper 512-byte framing and is a direct candidate for receiving a shifted/truncated/pre-read stream.

---

### 2. The PIO receive algorithm is substantially different from the vendor implementation

The vendor waits for a complete, CRC-valid block before draining exactly 512 bytes.

- Vendor ISR posts `rx_sema` only when receive-end/timeout is present and `DATA_CRC_OK` is asserted:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1390-1407`

- On CRC failure, the vendor resets the SD/FIFO state, records an error, and wakes the waiter with an error:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1408-1424`

- The PIO reader then consumes exactly 128 words for each 512-byte block:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1199-1228`

- Each FIFO word is obtained by polling `RX_FIFO_RD_READY`, with a bounded one-microsecond polling loop, then reading exactly once:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c:1178-1196`

The current implementation instead streams words concurrently with reception:

- It reads up to four words per pass:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:407-427`

- It inserts a fixed 300 µs delay after every read:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:422-425`

- It declares success as soon as 512 bytes have been copied, without waiting for receive-end or CRC status:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:576-581`

- It can also declare success after `DATA_CRC_FAIL` merely because all requested bytes happened to be drained:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:584-619`

- The receive-end branch does not require `DATA_CRC_OK`:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:622-636`

This permits an incomplete, misframed, or speculative pre-read block to be accepted as a successful sector. It also makes the fixed delay dependent on the programmed SD clock and peripheral-status update latency. The vendor implementation has neither the four-word batching nor the 300 µs delay.

---

### 3. The signature displacement is consistent with FIFO/framing loss, not byte endianness

If the `55 aa` at buffer offset 170 is the sector’s true terminal MBR signature, its expected offset is 510. The difference is:

```text
510 - 170 = 340 bytes = 85 32-bit FIFO words
```

That points to substantial data omission or to the buffer crossing into a subsequent speculative block. It is not explained by a simple byte swap.

Receive byte ordering itself matches the vendor:

  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:355-364`

  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h:276-278`

## Proposed changes

### Priority 1: Correct the 512-byte read framing

In `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:350-364`, program:

```c
value = BK7258_SDIO_DATA_MULTIBLOCK |
        BK7258_SDIO_DATA_BYTE_SELECT |
        ((512u << BK7258_SDIO_DATA_BLOCK_SHIFT) &
         BK7258_SDIO_DATA_BLOCK_MASK);
```

Then set `BK7258_SDIO_DATA_ENABLE`.

Do not retain the BK7256-specific zero-block-size exception for BK7258. This is the smallest and most directly relevant correction.

---

### Priority 2: Replace streaming FIFO draining with the vendor block-boundary algorithm

Replace `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:407-427` and the success logic at lines 562-655 with:

1. Wait for a receive-block event that has `DATA_RECEIVE_END` and `DATA_CRC_OK`.
2. Reject `DATA_TIMEOUT`, `FIFO_OVERFLOW`, or `DATA_CRC_FAIL`.
3. After the valid block event, read exactly `blocklen / 4` FIFO words.
4. For each word, poll `RX_READY` with a bounded timeout and read once immediately.
5. Remove the fixed 300 µs delay and four-word batching.
6. Preserve low-byte-first extraction or `memcpy()` on this little-endian target.

For faithful vendor synchronization, attach `BK7258_IRQ_SDIO`, enable receive-end/data-timeout interrupts, and post a receive semaphore from the ISR. Command completion may remain polling initially if minimizing changes, but receive completion should follow the vendor ISR/semaphore model.

---

### Priority 3: Never accept a block without positive CRC completion

Remove both current success shortcuts:

- `remaining == 0` success at:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:576-581`
- CRC-fail-but-buffer-full success at:
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:606-614`

A requested block is successful only after all 512 bytes were read and the corresponding hardware status contains `DATA_RECEIVE_END | DATA_CRC_OK`, with no timeout, overflow, or CRC-fail bit.

Treat later speculative pre-read CRC failures separately by resetting/discarding stale pre-read state before the next operation, as the vendor does.

### Priority 4: Guarantee CMD12 cleanup whenever CMD18 was accepted

Track whether CMD18 completed successfully at the command-response level. If it did, run the stop sequence even if data reception subsequently fails:

1. reset RX/TX/SD state,
2. force `CLOCK_GATE` bit 27 on,
3. send CMD12 once,
4. wait for its response,
5. clear interrupt-mask bit 13 if implemented,
6. restore automatic gating,
7. reset RX/TX/SD state again.

Apply this around `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_sdio.c:486-512`.

Create one logical reset sequence equivalent to `sdio_host_ll_reset_sd_state()`:

```text
RMW register 0x11, clearing bits 16, 17, and 20 while preserving
thresholds, clock recovery, sampling, and clock-gate policy.
```

Use it:

- during host reset,
- before configuring a new CMD18 read,
- before CMD12,
- after CMD12,
- on CRC/timeout/overflow.

Then explicitly set thresholds to `0x01/0x01` and clock recovery bit 25. Avoid open-coded sequences that clear all low 16 bits and then rewrite reset bits with ambiguous polarity.

Update `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_sdio.h` names/comments to state the actual reset assertion convention.

+
+---
+
+## 12. 2026-08-14 实板调试记录与当前结论
+
+本节记录本轮及前序 BK7258 SD-NAND/OpenVela SDIO 调试的实际结果。记录以
+`/home/mi/vela_competition` 工作区、目标板 `/dev/ttyUSB1` 和当前比赛仓库为准。
+
+### 12.1 已完成的移植内容
+
+- 确认原理图 pinout：GPIO14=`SD_CLK`、GPIO15=`SD_CMD`、GPIO16~19=`SD_D0~D3`。
+- 新增 BK7258 SDIO lower-half、硬件寄存器头文件和 SDIO PWC 电源/时钟请求。
+- 接入 `CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO`、CMake、Kconfig、IRQ、bring-up 和 MMCSD board glue。
+- 配置为只读、1-bit、PIO；未实现 DMA、写入、格式化或破坏性测试。
+- 注册固定只读几何的 `/dev/mmcsd0`：sector size 为 512，sector count 为 2097152。
+- `periph_selftest` 改为通过 block-driver geometry/read API 访问存储，避免 BCH 普通
+  `open()` 临时代理的 `ENXIO` 干扰。
+- 启用 BCH、MMCSD、MMCSD read-only、MBR parser、FAT/VFAT、单块限制和 1-bit 配置。
+- GPIO14~19 按原厂配置内部上拉和 drive capacity 3。
+
+### 12.2 已确认正常的部分
+
+SD-NAND 初始化命令链路在多轮冷启动中稳定成功：
+
+```text
+CMD8       -> 0x000001aa
+ACMD41     -> 0x80ff8000
+CMD2       -> response available
+CMD3       -> 0x21bb0500
+CMD9       -> response available
+CMD7       -> 0x00000700
+CMD16      -> 0x00000900
+ACMD51     -> data transfer completes for 8 bytes
+```
+
+已确认 OCR 的 CCS bit 为 0，因此该器件按 SDSC byte addressing 处理，直接读取时使用
+`sector << 9`。SDIO 现代寄存器窗口也已与 BK7258 原厂 V2 资料核对：
+
+```text
+SDIO base       = 0x458d0000
+RX FIFO         = 0x458d0040
+FIFO threshold  = 0x458d0044
+```
+
+构建、打包和烧录流程稳定成功。最近一次结果：
+
+```text
+build.sh ... -e -Werror --cmake -j8  -> build completed successfully
+EraseFlash                              -> pass
+{All Finished Successfully}
+all-app.bin                             -> 2646016 bytes
+```
+
+除存储外，最近一次 `periph_selftest` 通过了：
+
+```text
+PASS wlan0 interface present
+PASS mailbox UART TX
+PASS psram
+PASS /proc/version
+PASS /proc/uptime
+PASS /proc/meminfo
+PASS systick
+```
+
+### 12.3 原厂实现对照结果
+
+本轮逐项对照了以下原厂实现：
+
+```text
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdio_host/sdio_host_driver.c
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sd_card/sd_card_driver.c
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sdcard/sdcard.c
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sdio_ll.h
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_struct.h
+bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/sdio_reg.h
+```
+
+已在 OpenVela 路径中对齐或验证的项目包括：
+
+- BK7258 V2 的 512-byte `DATA_CTRL` block-size 字段。
+- `DATA_CTRL` 配置和 `DATA_EN` 启动分离写入。
+- data timeout、W1C interrupt status、RX FIFO/state reset 顺序。
+- RX threshold/TX threshold 为 `0x01`，clock recovery bit。
+- CMD18 多块读、CMD12 stop、clock gate 和读后 state reset。
+- FIFO 32-bit word 的低字节优先搬运。
+- `DATA_RECEIVE_END` 后清 W1C 状态，再消费 RX FIFO。
+- 100 kHz 和原厂 20 MHz clock code 的四位 divider 字段。
+- 负沿/正沿 sampling 对照。
+- 原厂 legacy block-size aperture `0x448b000c` 的兼容写入对照。
+
+原厂正式 V2 host 使用 ISR/semaphore 完成 command/data 同步；当前 OpenVela 首版仍是
+polling lower-half。这是当前最重要的结构性差异，不能用更多的固定 delay 或忽略 CRC
+来替代。
+
+### 12.4 已执行的实验及结果
+
+#### CMD17 单块读
+
+`CMD17` 能稳定得到前部 MBR 引导代码，例如：
+
+```text
+first = fa 33 c0 8e
+```
+
+但在完整 512-byte 请求中，后续 FIFO 内容主要为 `0xff`，sector 尾部没有 `55aa`。
+
+#### CMD18 多块读 + CMD12
+
+该组合可以搬运 512 字节，并且 CMD12 响应稳定：
+
+```text
+SDIO R1 CMD18=0x00000900
+SDIO R1 CMD12=0x00000b00
+```
+
+但数据不是有效 sector。曾观测到：
+
+```text
+first     = fa33c08e
+signature = offset 170 或 offset 208
+last      != 55aa
+```
+
+完整 dump 中虽然首部存在合法 MBR 引导字节，但后续数据呈现错位、重复或非 sector
+内容的特征，不能用于 FAT parser。
+
+#### 时钟和采样
+
+- 100 kHz：可以避免部分 FIFO overflow，但 sector 仍错位。
+- 20 MHz：数据 CRC 错误仍存在，不能提升为可用状态。
+- 正沿采样：与负沿结果没有实质改善，已恢复原厂负沿默认。
+- 6.5 MHz/100 kHz/20 MHz 多轮测试均未得到 offset 510 的稳定 `55aa`。
+
+#### FIFO pacing
+
+曾测试 100 us、1 us、300 us 固定 delay 和不同 burst 大小。固定 delay 会改变观测到的
+偏移，但不能使 sector 正确；这证明 delay 不是可靠修复。原厂路径是先等待 block event，

1126: ```text

1198: 
1199: #### CMD17 单块读
1200: 
1201: `CMD17` 能稳定得到前部 MBR 引导代码，例如：

1230: 
1231: - 100 kHz：可以避免部分 FIFO overflow，但 sector 仍错位。
1232: - 20 MHz：数据 CRC 错误仍存在，不能提升为可用状态。

1237: 
1238: 曾测试 100 us、1 us、300 us 固定 delay 和不同 burst 大小。固定 delay 会改变观测到的
1239: 偏移，但不能使 sector 正确；这证明 delay 不是可靠修复。原厂路径是先等待 block event，

1250: DATA_TIMEOUT/FIFO_OVERFLOW -> error
1251: DATA_RECEIVE_END + DATA_CRC_OK + complete FIFO block -> success

159: ### 2.1 NuttX Bluetooth Host 最小补丁
160: 
161: BK7258 BLE 重连还依赖比赛仓保存的 NuttX Host 补丁：
162: 
163: ```text
164: external/nuttx/patches/
165:   0001-bluetooth-fix-acl-buffer-and-connection-references.patch
166: ```
167: 
168: 该补丁只修改 `wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c` 的 `hci_acl()`：
169: 
170: ```c
171: bt_buf_addref(buf);
172: bt_conn_receive(conn, buf, flags);
173: bt_conn_release(conn);
174: ```
175: 
176: - `bt_buf_addref()` 为 L2CAP/ATT consumer 保留独立 ACL buffer 引用，避免 HCI RX
177:   worker 返回后形成双重释放或分片 PDU 悬空引用。
178: - `bt_conn_release()` 释放 `bt_conn_lookup_handle()` 返回的 connection 引用，避免
179:   每个入站 ACL 包泄漏引用并导致 `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONN=1` 的槽位在断开后
180:   无法复用。
181: 
182: 这两项是 NuttX Bluetooth Host 的通用引用计数修复，不属于 BK7258 Controller
183: 兼容逻辑。BK7258 特定的 HCI command 过滤、ACL PB 标准化和 mailbox credit 仍放在
184: `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_bt_transport.c`，不得复制进公共 Host 栈。
185: 
186: 在 OpenVela 工作区根目录构建前应用补丁：
187: 
188: ```bash
189: patch_file="$PWD/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/nuttx/patches/0001-bluetooth-fix-acl-buffer-and-connection-references.patch"
190: 
191: git -C nuttx apply --check "$patch_file"
192: git -C nuttx apply "$patch_file"
193: git -C nuttx diff --check
194: ```
195: 
196: 若 `git apply --check` 报告补丁已应用，先确认以下两行已经位于 `hci_acl()`，不要
197: 重复应用：
198: 
199: ```bash
200: grep -n -A3 'bt_buf_addref(buf)' nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c
201: ```
202: 
203: 验证补丁范围只能包含目标文件和两行行为修改：
204: 
205: ```bash
206: git -C nuttx diff --stat
207: git -C nuttx diff -- wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c
208: ```
209: 
210: 该文件是公共 NuttX 源码的补丁归档，不是 `bk_avdk_smp` 覆盖文件。正式方案仍应
211: 向对应 NuttX 公共仓库提交独立 PR；在公共修复合入前，本补丁保证比赛固件可复现。
